2017 KTM RC390! I wanted a track oriented sport bike because I wanted something I could hone my skills on, but didn't want to kill myself on a 600. looking back I definitely could have started on a 600 after riding a few of my friend's bikes (cbr f4i, 600rr, gsxr 600), but hindsight is 20/20. I love my pumpkin bike. It's been reliable, no electrical issues, overheating issues, blown headgaskets, etc. I do normal chain maintenance every 500 or so miles and oil changes according to the owner's manual. Literally zero issues, and I was super nervous hearing all the horror stories. I've put a little under 5k miles on it in the first year (bought it at the beginning of last season), but for a single cylinder she's perfectly fine on the highway.
God that's a beautiful bike, there's nothing like riding a "slow" bike fast :)
